## What to improve

What existing thing in the framework needs to change? Be specific — file path, skill name, or convention name.

## Current behavior

How does it work today? What's the friction or gap?

## Proposed behavior

What should it do instead? Why?

## Trade-offs

What does this proposal cost? What becomes harder if we accept it?

## Affected surface area

- [ ] Parent skill `lloydbriantech-ascent`
- [ ] One or more project-embedded skills (list: ____________)
- [ ] Reference modules (list: ____________)
- [ ] Template assets (list: ____________)
- [ ] Framework docs (list: ____________)
- [ ] Tooling (`make`, scripts, CI)
- [ ] Naming or convention (would require ADR)

## Backward compatibility

Would this change break existing scaffolded projects? If so:

- [ ] No, this is purely additive
- [ ] Yes, but a migration path is feasible
- [ ] Yes, and a migration path needs design

## Real-world motivation

What concrete experience led to this proposal? Specific is better than abstract.

---

*Before submitting, please confirm:*

- [ ] I've searched existing issues for duplicates
- [ ] I've considered backward compatibility
- [ ] The proposal preserves rather than erodes existing framework opinions
